title: Abnormal cases on the network side

entities.name: Timer T3594
entities.description: Timer used during service-level authentication procedure. On expiry, triggers retransmission of SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message.

entities.name: SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent by SMF for service-level authentication. Retransmitted on T3594 expiry.

entities.name: Service-level authentication procedure
entities.description: Authentication procedure performed at service level. Aborted after fifth T3594 expiry.

entities.name: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT
entities.description: Message sent when service-level authentication fails, containing 5GSM cause #29.

entities.name: Fifth T3594 expiry
entities.description: Condition when timer T3594 expires for the fifth time, triggering procedure abortion.

entities.name: Procedure abortion
entities.description: SMF behavior to abort the service-level authentication procedure after fifth T3594 expiry.

relations.description: Service-level authentication procedure starts timer T3594.
Procedure includes sending SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message.
On first four T3594 expiries, timer is reset and SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMMAND is resent.
Fifth T3594 expiry establishes procedure abortion behavior.
Procedure abortion includes sending PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message.
